non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: The 250-example Glaive mixture had the strongest clean preference validation among tested doses, while the 500-example mixture fell to 0.894444 accuracy and 0.671833 macro F1 on that same validation partition. A second 250-example draw with a different sampling and training seed, while holding the preference split fixed, will show whether the clean-validation gain is robust or sample-specific. Candidate selection will use clean validation only.

Record training metrics plus separate preference and Glaive clean validation before test evaluation.
